description: This file defines the TaxItem class, a subclass of OrderTotalItem, representing a tax-related item with associated tax rate and label in the sales management system.

classes.name: TaxItem
classes.description: A class representing a tax item with a label and associated tax rate, extending OrderTotalItem.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the tax item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the tax item.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Sets the tax rate associated with this tax item.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the tax rate associated with this tax item.
